events.title: Seattle Children’s Theatre Presents ‘Chicka Chicka Boom Boom: The Holiday Show’
events.loc: Seattle Children’s Theatre , 201 Thomas St., Seattle
events.desc: “Chicka Chicka Boom Boom” was one of my favorite books as a kid, and I am so excited to share the magic of it with my daughter! This whimsical production gives the story a holiday makeover, as the alphabet decorates a huge Christmas tree. You can expect festive songs and merry laughs (and some audience participation!).

events.title: Gingerbread Village
events.loc: Sheraton Grand Seattle , 1400 Sixth Ave., Seattle
events.desc: This fun holiday tradition is back for its 32nd year. Admire 6-foot-tall gingerbread masterpieces designed by architects, baked up by Sheraton chefs and brought to life by Breakthrough T1D elves. This year’s theme is The Great Seattle Gingerbread Games, in celebration of local sports culture.

events.title: Rumble in Redmond 2026: Robot Combat Competition
events.loc: Redmond Middle School , 10055 166th Ave. N.E., Redmond
events.desc: Robots battle it out this weekend in an epic competition. You won’t want to miss seeing them flip, spin and mash against each other in a battle of engineering and creativity. Head to the STEAM discovery zone for hands-on activities and a closer look at the technology behind the robots.

events.title: Salmon Fest at Mary Olson Farm
events.loc: Mary Olson Farm , 28728 Green River Rd. S.E., Auburn
events.desc: The salmon have returned to the stream at Mary Olson Farm. Bring your budding biologists along to observe their habitat, test the water and learn about the ecosystem. It’s the perfect excuse to spend the day outside while we (hopefully) have a break from the rain. Keep in mind that parking is limited at the farm, and carpooling is encouraged!

events.title: Tulalip Lights & Ice
events.desc: It’s hard to miss the 10 million lights twinkling in Tulalip for the holiday season, and believe me when I say it’s worth the visit! It all starts this weekend with Saturday’s lighting ceremony. Shop local vendors, meet the Clauses (and the Grinch!), and glide across the ice-skating rink.

events.title: Julefest: A Nordic Holiday Celebration
events.cost: $12 adults ($16 on-site); $5 youth; ages 11 and younger are free
events.loc: National Nordic Museum , 2655 N.W. Market St., Seattle
events.desc: Get into the holiday spirit by stepping into a winter wonderland. Indulge in delicious treats, listen to live music and pick out handcrafted gifts for everyone on your list. You can even try traditional Scandinavian foods. Plus, just outside the museum you’ll meet one of my favorite Dambo trolls : Frankie Feetsplinter.

events.title: Fantasy Lights Walk
events.cost: $5 per person; ages 3 and younger free
events.loc: Spanaway Park , 1000 Military Rd. S., Spanaway
events.desc: Take a 2-mile stroll through sparkling light displays during this pedestrian-only preview of Fantasy Lights. And consider dinner sorted (music to my ears), as there will be a variety of food trucks on-site. Tickets are going fast!

events.title: Jimi Hendrix Celebration
events.loc: Northwest African American Museum , 2300 S. Massachusetts St., Seattle
events.desc: Experience the music and legacy of Jimi Hendrix during this free celebration. There will be a live performance by Claytin Hendrix, along with an interactive craft station and special raffle. While you’re there, grab lunch from West Coast Seattle Boy.

events.title: The Stories Water Keeps: Free Film Festival, Family Activities, and More
events.desc: Grab your budding marine biologists and head to the waterfront for this free marine-themed festival. Watch “Moana,” chat with a mermaid and make crafts. You can also meet Eba, the adorable working dog who sniffs out whale poop!
